moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Launch Night!
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns tonight with its highly anticipated launch show, revealing the celebrity-professional pairings for the 2026 series and introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: It's HERE! The Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch show is on BBC One tonight at 7:25 PM. Who are you most excited to see paired up? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts Take Over
angles.copy: New faces in the ballroom! Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe take the reins as Strictly hosts tonight. Tune in at 7:25 PM on BBC One.

moments.title: Premier League Saturday Action
moments.blurb: Five Premier League fixtures are scheduled for today, including Tottenham Hotspur facing Aston Villa and Newcastle United hosting Hull City.

angles.name: Saturday Football Focus
angles.copy: Premier League Saturday! Big games today including Tottenham vs Aston Villa and Newcastle vs Hull. What's your prediction for the 3 PM kick-offs?

angles.name: Local Team Shoutout (NCL)
angles.copy: It's match day for the Magpies! Newcastle United host Hull City at St James' Park this afternoon. How are we feeling, Toon Army? #NUFC

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Jarvis Cocker
moments.blurb: Jarvis Cocker, the iconic frontman of Britpop band Pulp, celebrates his 63rd birthday today.

angles.name: Pulp Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Jarvis Cocker! What's your favourite Pulp track to get you dancing? #JarvisCocker

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: A true Britpop legend turns 63 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to Pulp's inimitable frontman, Jarvis Cocker.

moments.title: Nile Rodgers Turns 74

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: Happy 74th Birthday to the legendary Nile Rodgers! From Chic to Daft Punk, his guitar riffs are pure magic. What's your favourite track he's touched? #NileRodgers

angles.name: Production Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 74th birthday to the man behind so many hits, Nile Rodgers! A true icon of music production and performance.

angles.name: Grime Icon

angles.name: UK Rap Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 45th birthday to the one and only Skepta! Still pushing boundaries and setting trends.

angles.name: Grunge Bassist

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a future happy 58th to Soundgarden bassist Ben Shepherd, celebrating tomorrow!

moments.title: Bake Off is Back!
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22, at 8 PM on Channel 4, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: New Bake Off Season
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and showstoppers! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday at 8 PM on Channel 4. Who's excited for Cake Week?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: A delicious new addition to the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge when the series returns Tuesday at 8 PM.

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Arrives
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23, at 1:06 AM BST.

angles.name: First Day of Autumn
angles.copy: The astronomical Autumn Equinox is just around the corner, arriving Wednesday! Time for cosy nights, pumpkin spice, and crunchy leaves. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: Wednesday marks the Autumn Equinox at 1:06 AM BST. The days will now officially be shorter than the nights. Time to embrace the new season!

angles.name: The Boss's Birthday

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the rock icon, Bruce Springsteen, celebrating this Wednesday!

moments.title: Tribute to John Coltrane at 100
moments.blurb: Wednesday, September 23rd, would have marked the 100th birthday of groundbreaking jazz saxophonist John Coltrane, who passed away in 1967.

angles.name: Jazz Giant Centennial
angles.copy: On Wednesday, we remember the unparalleled jazz visionary John Coltrane, who would have turned 100. His influence continues to resonate globally. #JohnColtrane

angles.name: A Musical Legacy
angles.copy: A century since his birth, John Coltrane's revolutionary sound lives on. Remembering the jazz giant this Wednesday, September 23rd.

moments.title: Harvest Moon Illuminates Skies
moments.blurb: The Harvest Moon, the full moon closest to the Autumn Equinox, will appear on Saturday, September 26, at 5:49 PM BST.

angles.name: Full Moon Magic
angles.copy: Look up this Saturday! The beautiful Harvest Moon will light up our skies at 5:49 PM BST. Perfect for a late-night stroll. #HarvestMoon

angles.name: Autumnal Glow
angles.copy: The Harvest Moon is traditionally associated with gathering crops. Catch its glow this Saturday, September 26th!
